turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have eighteen minutes before a client call. Owen's grade was changed on the gradebook without a word to me. Where do we start, Hale?
I don't think this is productive.
"Not productive." I'm writing that down. Who decided to enter the zero before anyone called me, and will you withdraw it today?
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
You have a class in ten minutes, and Owen has a zero he found out about on his phone. Sit down and answer my question, or I go to the principal's office next. Who decided, Hale?
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.
"Email the principal if you want." I'm writing that down, word for word. I'm going upstairs now, and I'll want the zero withdrawn and a written answer on who decided, before the end of today.
